title: Marketplace
notConnectedYet: Marketplace will be built in P12.

browser.title: Partners directory
browser.subtitle: Verified partners and offers. The crown comes only from a live verification record, never from a user-written field.
browser.crownNote: The Verified badge appears only with a live verification record. Demo values are labeled and are not real prices.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search by partner name or description
browser.emptyDescription: Widen or clear the filters. You can populate demo data from developer settings.
browser.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching partners. Please retry.
browser.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

profile.title: Partner profile
profile.notFoundDescription: We could not find this partner. It may have been removed or the link is invalid.
profile.notVerifiedNote: This partner is not verified right now. No verification badge is shown; confirm details before dealing.

offers.title: Partner offers
offers.subtitle: Published offers only. Drafts and in-review offers never appear here.
offers.emptyDescription: Offers appear after review and publication. No demo offer is presented as real.

detail.title: Offer details
detail.howNote: Contact the partner directly and mention you are from AZIB. No in-app payment and no commission; eligibility is checked at the partner without revealing your identity to anyone else.
detail.audienceNote: The beneficiary category is a provisional policy: approved beneficiaries only for now.
detail.viewsSuppressed: View count is withheld to protect privacy at small numbers.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this offer. It may have been cancelled or the link is invalid.

audience.pendingPolicy: This option awaits approval of the beneficiary-category policy.

external.whatsappDescription: WhatsApp will open with the partner's number. No data from your account is sent, and you will leave the app.
external.mapsDescription: Your maps app will open at the partner's location. You will leave the app.
external.failed: Could not open the external app. Please try again.

report.title: Report an offer
report.received: Your report was received and will be reviewed by the responsible team. Thank you for keeping the directory accurate.

saved.title: Saved offers
saved.subtitle: Your private list. Nobody else can see it.
saved.emptyDescription: Save any offer from its details screen to see it here.
saved.privateNote: Saving is local to your account and is not shared with the partner or any other user.

media.privateNote: Images are processed to drop location metadata before upload; verification documents are visible to authorized reviewers only.

register.title: Register a partner
register.subtitle: Register your business and attach verification documents. Review is human.
register.reviewNote: After submission the status becomes Pending verification. The crown is granted only by an authorized verifier.

help.whatsapp: Optional. If left empty the contact number is used.

register.documentsHelp: At least one document. These are visible to authorized reviewers only.
register.terms: I accept the cooperation terms and the accuracy of the submitted data.
register.privateNote: No card or bank data is requested, and no fees are charged.

dashboard.title: Partner dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your business status, offers and aggregated, privacy-safe view stats.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Register your business to be able to submit offers.
dashboard.notVerifiedNote: Your business is not verified yet; offers cannot be published before verification.
dashboard.offersEmptyDescription: Create an offer to be reviewed and then published.

composer.title: New offer
composer.subtitle: Set the discount type and value, products, duration and terms.
composer.reviewNote: The offer is reviewed by a human before publication. No in-app payment and no commission.
composer.noPartner: You must register a business first to submit an offer.
composer.audienceNote: Disabled options await approval of the beneficiary-category policy.
composer.noPaymentNote: The platform collects no money and tracks no payment.

ambassador.title: AZIB ambassadors
ambassador.subtitle: Field tasks in your assigned regions: nominating partners and activity verification photos.
ambassador.privacyNote: Ambassadors never reach verification documents or any beneficiary data. Their permissions are field-only.
ambassador.motivation: Why do you want to be an ambassador?
ambassador.tasksEmptyDescription: Tasks are assigned by the responsible team in your approved regions.
ambassador.taskNominate: Nominate a new partner in your region

dev.title: Partners simulator
dev.subtitle: Internal tool to run verification decisions and offer reviews through the same services. No automated decision in the user path.
dev.notDemo: This simulator works in demo mode only.
dev.partnersEmpty: No partners. Register a business from the registration screen.
dev.rejectReason: The documents are insufficient for verification.
dev.applied: Decision applied and recorded in the audit trail.

demo.notice: Every partner and offer here is demo data and does not represent real businesses or prices.

validation.title: Enter an offer title (at least 3 characters).
validation.discountValue: Enter a valid value greater than zero.
validation.percentRange: The discount rate must not exceed 100.
validation.validityWindow: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.reportDetail: Describe the report in at least 10 characters.
validation.businessName: Enter the business name (at least 3 characters).
validation.description: Describe the business in at least 10 characters.
validation.phone: Enter a valid Yemeni contact number.
validation.documents: Attach at least one verification document.
validation.terms: Accepting the cooperation terms is required.
validation.motivation: Explain your motivation in at least 20 characters.
validation.taskEvidence: Attach a photo or nominate a partner before submitting the task.

errors.noSession: Sign-in is required for this action.

browser.title: Souk Khair
browser.subtitle: In-kind donations between families: furniture, appliances, home essentials and free services.
browser.noPriceNote: No prices, no selling, no money in exchange. Every item is an in-kind donation, and reselling received items is forbidden.
browser.areaNote: General area only — no exact address and no contact number in the description.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search by item title or description
browser.emptyDescription: Add the first in-kind donation, or widen the filters. Labelled demo items do not represent real people.
browser.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching Souk Khair items. Please retry.
browser.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

detail.title: Item details
detail.privacyNote: No exact address and no contact number are shown. Contact starts inside the app after the request is accepted and both parties consent.
detail.noResaleNote: Condition of benefit: received donations must not be resold or used for money in exchange.
detail.unavailable: This item is not available for requests right now.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this item. It may have been withdrawn or the link is invalid.

composer.title: Add an in-kind donation
composer.subtitle: Add an item to donate. There is no price field; the optional estimate is for statistics only.
composer.noPriceNote: Do not mention a price, money in exchange, or a contact number in the title or description.
composer.descriptionHelp: Write a useful description with no phone numbers, links or exact address.
composer.imagesHelp: Up to {{max}} images. Compressed and stripped of location metadata before upload.
composer.exifNote: If processing fails, nothing is uploaded — for your privacy.
composer.noResale: I confirm this is an in-kind donation and accept the no-resale condition.

request.title: Request to benefit
request.subtitle: Briefly explain your need. The donor or the team reviews the request.
request.limitNote: Active requests are limited, and you cannot request the same item twice.
request.noPaymentNote: No payment and no money in exchange. Handover is confirmed by both parties with a code.

mine.title: My donations
mine.subtitle: Your items and their statuses. Publish a draft, withdraw an item, or relist it.
mine.emptyDescription: Add an in-kind item so it appears here and you can publish it.

requests.title: My requests
requests.subtitle: The benefit requests you submitted and their statuses.
requests.emptyDescription: Browse Souk Khair and submit a benefit request on a suitable item.
requests.coordinationNote: Coordination, chat, contact disclosure and code handover ship in the next part of P12.

coordination.title: Coordination
coordination.subtitle: Limited text chat after the request is accepted, with contact disclosure by mutual consent.

safe.publicPlace: Agree on a well-known public place, not a private home address.
safe.daylight: Prefer daylight, and tell someone you trust about the meeting.
safe.companion: Bring a companion if possible, especially when moving heavy furniture.
safe.noPayment: No money in exchange and no mandatory transport fees. The donation is in-kind with no financial conditions.
safe.report: If you feel unsafe or pressured, stop the meeting and report the item from its screen.

coordination.chatEmpty: No messages yet. Start with a short text message.
coordination.notAccepted: Chat and contact disclosure are available only after the request is accepted.
coordination.consentMine: I agree to disclose my number to the other party
coordination.consentNote: No number is disclosed before the request is accepted and both parties consent. You can withdraw consent anytime.
coordination.callNote: The number comes from the other party's profile. Dial it manually from your phone — we never place a call for you.

handover.title: Handover confirmation
handover.subtitle: Handover is confirmed by both parties with the code. One confirmation is not enough.
handover.codeHelp: Enter the code shown on the coordination screen. Both parties exchange it at the meeting.
handover.waiting: Waiting for the other party's confirmation.
handover.demoNote: Demo code — the official code is minted server-side in P18.
handover.rateHelp: Rate the experience quality from 1 to 5. No moral rating and no scoring of people.
handover.rated: Thank you. Your rating is staff-private for service improvement and is never shown publicly.
handover.privateNote: The rating is not visible to any other user and affects nobody's eligibility.

inbox.title: Requests on my donations
inbox.subtitle: Review benefit requests on your items and accept or reject with a reason.
inbox.emptyDescription: When someone requests one of your items, the request appears here.
inbox.rejectReason: The item is no longer available or the request does not fit its condition.

reportScreen.title: Report an item
reportScreen.subtitle: Help us keep Souk Khair free of commodification and misleading content.
reportScreen.received: Your report was received and will be reviewed by the responsible team. Your identity is not shown to the item owner.

dev.title: Souk simulator
dev.subtitle: Internal tool to review items, requests and reports through the same services. No automated decision in the user path.
dev.notDemo: This simulator works in demo mode only.
dev.itemsEmpty: No items. Add a donation from the composer screen.
dev.rejectReason: The item violates Souk Khair conditions.
dev.applied: Decision applied and recorded in the audit trail.

images.demoNote: Demo images — real image rendering activates with real storage in P18.

estimated.label: Estimated value (optional)
estimated.help: For internal statistics only. Never shown as a price and never in the impact report.
estimated.unverified: Unverified — the donor's estimate, not a price and binding on nobody.

disclosure.not_a_party: You are not a party to this request.
disclosure.not_accepted: Contact is not disclosed before the request is accepted.
disclosure.awaiting_consents: Waiting for both parties to consent to disclosure.
disclosure.ready: Contact disclosed with both parties' consent.

antiCommodification.warning: Words suggesting selling or money in exchange were found. Souk Khair is in-kind only — reword it or report the item.

duplicate.fingerprint: An image fingerprint matches another item (the fingerprint is metadata-based; renaming evades it).
duplicate.titleArea: The same title and area as one of your earlier items.

reasons.forSale: Offered for sale or money in exchange
reasons.unavailable: The item is not actually available

validation.title: Enter an item title (at least 3 characters).
validation.description: Write a description in at least 10 characters.
validation.noResale: Accepting the no-resale condition is required.
validation.reason: Explain your need in at least 10 characters.
validation.reportDetail: Describe the report in at least 10 characters.

demo.notice: Every item here is demo data and does not represent real people or real offers.
